[[section: setup]]

Add your attribution header before the first request.

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Attribution: your-app/1.0" https://api.example.com/v1/echo
```

[[section: usage]]

Later, call the endpoint from your application code.

```bash
curl -H "X-Attribution: your-app/1.0" https://api.example.com/v1/echo
```

[[section: setup]]

Install the client, then make your first request.

```bash
curl -d 'hello' https://api.example.com/v1/echo
```
